title: Morning routine selfie
prompt_en: Vertical 9:16 selfie-style video. A young woman in a bathroom mirror holds her phone, smiles and lifts a small skincare jar toward the camera, then nods. Natural bathroom light, slightly handheld, authentic casual feel, no text.
prompt_zh: 竖屏 9:16 自拍风格。年轻女性在浴室镜前举着手机，微笑并把一小罐护肤品举向镜头，然后点头。自然的浴室光线，轻微手持晃动，真实随意的感觉，无文字。
why_it_works: UGC works when it looks unpolished: handheld feel, natural light and a single simple gesture.
result_check: Feels like phone footage, not studio
